stickerCreation.canvas.where: Drawing screen: the white sheet you draw on, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.timer.label.where: Drawing screen, top left: the timer dot's name for screen readers before the first stroke starts the clock

stickerCreation.timer.pause.where: Drawing screen, top left: the timer dot's name for screen readers while the clock runs; a tap pauses it

stickerCreation.timer.resume.where: Drawing screen, top left: the timer dot's name for screen readers after you paused it; a tap resumes it

stickerCreation.timer.paused.where: Drawing screen, top left: the small white tag with a pause icon that hangs off the timer dot whenever the clock is stopped; hidden from screen readers

stickerCreation.timer.status.running.where: Drawing screen, top left: read by screen readers after the timer dot's name while the clock runs; {{time}} is minutes:seconds, such as 4:32

stickerCreation.timer.status.waiting.where: Drawing screen, top left: read by screen readers after the timer dot's name before the first stroke starts the clock
stickerCreation.timer.status.waiting.ja: 残り{{time}}、かき始めるとスタート

stickerCreation.timer.status.paused.where: Drawing screen, top left: read by screen readers after the timer dot's name while the clock is stopped by a tap on the timer, by the app going to the background, or by another screen covering the drawing screen

stickerCreation.timer.status.color.where: Drawing screen, top left: read by screen readers after the timer dot's name while the color sheet is open, which stops the clock
stickerCreation.timer.status.color.ja: 残り{{time}}、色を選んでいる間は一時停止中

stickerCreation.timer.status.smoothing.where: Drawing screen, top left: read by screen readers after the timer dot's name while the smoothing bar is open, which stops the clock
stickerCreation.timer.status.smoothing.ja: 残り{{time}}、手ぶれ補正を調整している間は一時停止中

stickerCreation.timer.status.size.where: Drawing screen, top left: read by screen readers after the timer dot's name while a finger is on the size rail, which stops the clock
stickerCreation.timer.status.size.ja: 残り{{time}}、ブラシのサイズを調整している間は一時停止中

stickerCreation.timer.note.tapToKeepDraw.where: Drawing screen, top left: the white label under the timer for a few seconds when you draw on a paused sheet, also announced; the label never wraps by itself, so the line break is where it wraps
stickerCreation.timer.note.tapToKeepDraw.ja:
タイマーをタップすると
続きをかけます。

stickerCreation.timer.note.startsWhenYou.where: Drawing screen, top left: the white label under the timer after Start on your first few visits, or when you tap the timer before the first stroke; also announced
stickerCreation.timer.note.startsWhenYou.ja: かき始めるとスタート

stickerCreation.timer.note.pickedUp.where: Drawing screen, top left: the white label under the timer when a reload brings back your drawing in progress, paused, until the clock runs again; also announced
stickerCreation.timer.note.pickedUp.ja: 続きから再開しました

stickerCreation.timer.note.ticketCarries.where: Drawing screen, top left: the white label under the timer when a reload couldn't bring back your drawing, so a fresh sheet uses the same ticket, until the first stroke; also announced; the label never wraps by itself
stickerCreation.timer.note.ticketCarries.ja:
続きから再開できなかったので、
チケットはそのまま使えます

stickerCreation.startNote.lost.where: Drawing screen, the start card that asks before a ticket is spent: a note under its line when a reload couldn't bring back your drawing in progress
stickerCreation.startNote.lost.ja: 前回の続きから再開できませんでした。

stickerCreation.startNote.ticketFailed.where: Drawing screen, the start card that asks before a ticket is spent: a note under its line when tapping Start couldn't spend the ticket; {{reason}} is the server's error message
stickerCreation.startNote.ticketFailed.ja: チケットを使えませんでした。{{reason}}

stickerCreation.seal.label.where: Drawing screen, bottom right: the seal key's name for screen readers until its first tap arms it; the key shows a check mark

stickerCreation.seal.tapAgain.where: Drawing screen, bottom right: the chip beside the seal key after its first tap, announced to screen readers and the key's name until the second tap, which seals
stickerCreation.seal.tapAgain.ja: もう一度タップで仕上げ

stickerCreation.seal.empty.where: Drawing screen, bottom right: the chip beside the seal key, announced, when it's tapped but everything drawn was erased or undone
stickerCreation.seal.empty.ja: キャンバスが真っ白なので、仕上げるものがありません。

stickerCreation.seal.emptyAtTimeUp.where: Drawing screen: a toast when time runs out after everything drawn was erased or undone; the sheet then resets
stickerCreation.seal.emptyAtTimeUp.ja: 時間切れです。キャンバスが真っ白だったので、何も仕上がりませんでした。

stickerCreation.seal.failed.where: Drawing screen, bottom right: the chip beside the seal key, announced, when the server refused or didn't answer the seal; {{reason}} is the server's error message; the check is the seal key's icon
stickerCreation.seal.failed.ja: 仕上げられませんでした。{{reason}}チェックをタップして、もう一度お試しください。

stickerCreation.seal.failedHere.where: Drawing screen, bottom right: the chip beside the seal key, announced, when sealing failed on the phone before the server was asked; {{reason}} is a technical message that stays English
stickerCreation.seal.failedHere.ja: 仕上げられませんでした（{{reason}}）。チェックをタップして、もう一度お試しください。

stickerCreation.tools.label.where: Drawing screen, top right: the tool strip's name for screen readers

stickerCreation.tools.brush.where: Drawing screen, top right: the brush tile in the tool strip, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.tools.eraser.where: Drawing screen, top right: the eraser tile in the tool strip, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.tools.fill.where: Drawing screen, top right: the paint bucket tile in the tool strip, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.tools.color.where: Drawing screen, top right: the color tile in the tool strip, which opens the color sheet, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.tools.smoothing.where: Drawing screen, top right: the smoothing tile's name for screen readers, the title of the smoothing bar it opens, and that bar's slider's name

stickerCreation.colorSheet.title.where: Color sheet, which slides up over the drawing screen from the color tile: its heading, and its name for screen readers

stickerCreation.colorSheet.recent.where: Color sheet: the small label to the left of the row of recently used colors, 50px wide; hidden from screen readers

stickerCreation.colorSheet.recentColors.where: Color sheet: the row of recently used colors, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatches.where: Color sheet: the grid of 30 preset colors, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.colorSheet.huePad.where: Color sheet: the hue and saturation pad, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.colorSheet.huePadValue.where: Color sheet: read by screen readers as the hue and saturation pad moves; {{hue}} is 0 to 359 and {{saturation}} 0 to 100

stickerCreation.colorSheet.brightness.where: Color sheet: the brightness bar under the pad, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.i.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Ink preset color, #1C1824, a violet near-black

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.c.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Charcoal preset color, #4A4453, a dark gray

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.g.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Graphite preset color, #6E6878, a mid gray

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.s.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Stone preset color, #A39E93, a warm light gray
Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Sand preset color, #D9D4CB, a pale gray beige

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.w.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the White preset color, #FFFFFF

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.c.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Cream preset color, #FFF1D6

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.p.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Peach preset color, #FFE0C7, a pale skin tone

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.t.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Tan preset color, #E8B48C, a tanned skin tone

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.b.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Brown preset color, #9A6444

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.y.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Yellow preset color, #FFD93B

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.a.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Amber preset color, #FFB547, a golden orange
Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Apricot preset color, #F7A541

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.o.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Orange preset color, #FF7A45

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.t.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Tomato preset color, #FF5A36, a red orange

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.r.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Red preset color, #E8484F

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.b.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Brick preset color, #B8472E

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.c.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Chestnut preset color, #7A4A2E
Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Caramel preset color, #C58A4A
Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Cocoa preset color, #4A2F25, a dark brown

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.b.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Blush preset color, #FFB8C9, a soft pink

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.s.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Salmon preset color, #FF9E9E

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.p.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Pink preset color, #FF4F9A, a hot pink

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.l.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Lilac preset color, #CDBEFF, a pale purple

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.g.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Grape preset color, #9B7BFF, a violet

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.n.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Navy preset color, #3B3F8F, the color a first session starts with

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.b.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Blue preset color, #2F6BFF

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.s.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Sky preset color, #7CC6FF, a light blue

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.a.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Aqua preset color, #38D3DC, a turquoise

stickerCreation.colorSheet.swatchNames.i.where: Color sheet: screen readers' name for the Ice preset color, #BDEFF2, a pale aqua

stickerCreation.sizeRail.brush.where: Drawing screen, left edge: the size rail's name for screen readers while the brush or the fill is in hand

stickerCreation.sizeRail.eraser.where: Drawing screen, left edge: the size rail's name for screen readers while the eraser is in hand

stickerCreation.sizeRail.value.where: Drawing screen, left edge: read by screen readers as the size rail moves; {{size}} is 1 to 48; the number shown on the rail doesn't use this text

stickerCreation.smoothingBar.raw.where: Smoothing bar, under the tool strip: the small label at the slider's left end, no smoothing; hidden from screen readers

stickerCreation.smoothingBar.smooth.where: Smoothing bar, under the tool strip: the small label at the slider's right end, the most smoothing; hidden from screen readers

stickerCreation.history.undo.where: Drawing screen, bottom left: the undo tile, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.history.redo.where: Drawing screen, bottom left: the redo tile, named for screen readers

stickerCreation.sealCeremony.sealing.where: Drawing screen: announced to screen readers as the seal ceremony starts, while the sticker is cut out, domed with resin and peeled onto the sealed card
stickerCreation.sealCeremony.sealing.ja: シールを仕上げています

stickerCreation.sealedCard.title.where: Sealed card, the backing card the new sticker lands on at the end of the seal ceremony: its title, under the sticker

stickerCreation.sealedCard.finePrint.where: Sealed card: the fine print under the title; {{no}} is the sticker's number (No.0012), <duration/> its drawing time (3分12秒), {{day}} the day it was sealed (2026.09.27) and <handle/> your @handle

stickerCreation.sealedCard.keepDrawing.where: Sealed card: the main key while you have tickets left; it opens a fresh sheet for the next sticker

stickerCreation.sealedCard.goToStickerBo.where: Sealed card: the button at the bottom while you have tickets left, or the main key after your last ticket; it goes to your sticker board

stickerCreation.sealedCard.shopForTicket.where: Sealed card: the button at the bottom after your last ticket; it opens the ticket shop

stickerCreation.sealedCard.dailyTicketsL.where: Sealed card: the row of daily ticket stubs, named for screen readers with how many daily tickets are left today (one)
Sealed card: the row of daily ticket stubs, named for screen readers with how many daily tickets are left today
stickerCreation.sealedCard.dailyTicketsL.ja: 今日の無償チケットは残り{{count}}枚

stickerCreation.sealedCard.reserveTicket.where: Sealed card: the reserve ticket count beside the stubs, read by screen readers (one)
Sealed card: the reserve ticket count beside the stubs, read by screen readers

stickerCreation.sealedCard.lastTicket.where: Sealed card: the line under the tickets after you used your last ticket of either kind; {{time}} is when daily tickets refill (0:00 in Japanese)
stickerCreation.sealedCard.lastTicket.ja: これが今日最後のチケットでした。{{time}}に新しい無償チケットが届きます

stickerCreation.sealedCard.lastDailyTick.where: Sealed card: the line under the tickets after the day's last daily ticket, while reserve tickets remain; {{time}} is when daily tickets refill (0:00 in Japanese)
stickerCreation.sealedCard.lastDailyTick.ja: これが今日最後の無償チケットでした。{{time}}に新しい無償チケットが届きます
